features.title: Product and architecture baseline
acceptance: V0.1 is explicitly agent-native and local-first.
The product targets technical job seekers and AI tool users.
Public Web SaaS and a custom agent runtime are out of scope.
Resume and deletion safety are enforced by Core boundaries.

features.title: Executable Spec and Loop Harness
acceptance: The next executable feature is selected from status and dependencies.
Feature checks enforce allowed paths and declared commands.
Done status requires passing machine-readable evidence.

features.title: Local Workspace and multiple Search Plans
acceptance: Every personal record belongs to an explicit workspace.
One workspace can store multiple isolated Search Plans.
SQLite migrations are repeatable and foreign keys are enforced.
Workspace isolation and deletion scope have automated tests.

features.title: Core API independent from FastAPI
acceptance: Core imports no FastAPI, MCP SDK, agent SDK, or UI package.
Core services expose typed use-case methods.
Adapters can be replaced without changing domain behavior.

features.title: CLI adapter foundation
acceptance: CLI calls Core directly without FastAPI.
CLI can create a Workspace and multiple Search Plans.
CLI output is machine-readable JSON.

features.title: Local resume lifecycle and confirmed profile
acceptance: The host agent does not need to read the complete resume.
Reference, managed, and forget-source modes are implemented.
Only confirmed facts and minimum evidence are returned to adapters.
Temporary full text and sources follow the selected retention policy.

features.title: Official-source discovery and deterministic matching
acceptance: URL, CSV, JSON, one public ATS, and one official career site are covered.
Recruitment platform data is used only through public, exported, or explicitly authorized paths.
No connector bypasses login, CAPTCHA, anti-bot controls, robots policy, or platform terms.
Normalization, deduplication, freshness, filters, and ranking need no model.
Every result retains source, liveness, and match evidence.

features.title: Offline evaluation and release gates
acceptance: A versioned 100 to 300 case dataset covers matching, freshness, and deduplication.
All product quality claims are generated by scripts.
Bad cases become regression tests.

features.title: Product-grade CLI adapter
acceptance: CLI completes profile, plan, search, state, export, and deletion workflows.
CLI calls Core directly and supports Markdown and JSON output.
CLI remains the fallback when MCP or host path access fails.

features.title: Local stdio MCP server
acceptance: Seven high-level tools use strict schemas and call Core.
MCP contains no matching or persistence rules.
Deletion requires Core-enforced preview and confirm phases.
Malicious or approval-free clients cannot bypass safety.

features.title: Qwen Code, Codex and Claude Code integrations
acceptance: Skills do not read complete resumes and use the seven MCP tools correctly.
Skills ask only for missing constraints that change search results.
Qwen Code, Codex and Claude Code pass the same integration scenarios.

features.title: Mainstream Agent MCP compatibility matrix
acceptance: Only tested clients are listed as officially supported.
Cherry Studio, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code and OpenCode are evaluated against one shared scenario suite.
Unsupported schema, approval and transport behavior is documented without platform-specific business logic.

features.title: One-command install and doctor
acceptance: Qwen Code, Codex and Claude Code installations require one explicit command each.
Existing host configuration is backed up and never silently overwritten.
Doctor diagnoses database, permissions, MCP, connectors, and secret storage.

features.title: Initial real official-source validation
acceptance: The complete flow is exercised against a provenance-preserving snapshot from a real public official source.
The initial run records discovery, matching, source links, and bad cases.
One to two weeks of personal use remains a separate release claim and is not fabricated.
No product claim is made without field or evaluation evidence.

features.title: Local scheduler and Feishu summaries
acceptance: Monitoring runs only with explicit consent and documented online requirements.
Runs are idempotent and recover safely after missed schedules.
Feishu summaries are signed, bounded, pausable, and revocable.

features.title: Release hardening and contract alignment
acceptance: MCP can confirm a locally parsed profile without adding an eighth tool.
search_jobs can discover from explicit public or local sources before matching.
Job state changes retain append-only history.
Install, upgrade, uninstall, and doctor work from an installed package.
README, specification, CI, package metadata, and implementation agree.
A clean-environment package smoke test passes.

features.title: Zero-ID onboarding and active search configuration
acceptance: setup_profile works without a user-managed workspace ID.
configure_search creates or updates an active Search Plan and source subscriptions.
search_jobs works without a user-managed workspace or plan ID.
Explicit IDs remain available for advanced multi-workspace use.

features.title: Profile-grounded deterministic matching
acceptance: Confirmed profile facts change ranking for otherwise identical Search Plans.
Match explanations link profile evidence to job evidence.
Missing required skills and experience gaps are explicit warnings.
Chinese role aliases and word or n-gram tokens have regression tests.

features.title: Subscription-backed discovery monitoring
acceptance: Search Plan source subscriptions persist connector configuration and health.
Every monitor run discovers before matching.
Missing source records can transition to closed only after a successful source refresh.
Notifications contain only newly matched jobs.

features.title: Bounded MCP output and source security
acceptance: MCP list and search calls return bounded summaries instead of full descriptions.
Single-job details are explicit and marked as untrusted external content.
MCP export writes locally and returns metadata rather than private records.
Every HTTP redirect target is validated before a connection is made.
Salary and cross-source identity preserve raw evidence and normalized fields.
README describes actual capabilities and evidence without synthetic quality claims.

features.title: Ashby public job-board connector (removed — 0 China AI jobs)
acceptance: Ashby's documented public job-board API is supported without credentials.
Only listed jobs are imported and source evidence is retained.
Locations, published time, plain description, apply URL, and salary evidence are normalized.
The connector is contract-tested without claiming live regional validation.

features.title: China official-career source validation
acceptance: At least one stable public China enterprise career source is validated without login or anti-bot bypass.
The validation fixture preserves provenance and a retrieval date.
Active, closed, changed, and duplicate job behavior is covered.
The field-trial report distinguishes observed facts from assumptions.

features.title: V0.2 RC release semantics and China location aliases
acceptance: Package, MCP server, release report, and Git tag use V0.2 RC semantics.
Chinese city filters match equivalent English locations from public sources.
M14 benchmark labeling and M15 field use can proceed in parallel.
The seven-day trial only counts China-located roles and observed behavior.

features.title: China recommendation quality gate and source catalog
acceptance: Resume Parser V3 groups wrapped resume sections into skills, projects, experience, and education.
Location-only non-technical jobs cannot enter AI-role candidates.
Remote fetch supports gzip, bounded retries, and last-successful-snapshot fallback.
China searches receive maintained connectors and official company/platform search links without ATS parameters.
Baidu public social-job search returns real China AI candidates through a maintained Connector.
Profile import and review use bounded pagination instead of returning every fact.

features.title: Installed-package and two-call first-use recovery
acceptance: The built wheel contains every ordered SQL migration and initializes all required tables.
CI installs the built wheel and completes workspace, doctor, and MCP empty-result smoke checks.
Every successful MCP tool result uses an object-valued structuredContent payload.
The default Agent path auto-confirms parsed facts, configures maintained sources, and searches in one user turn.
Users are not asked for Workspace, Plan, ATS, board, or career connector internals.

features.title: Migration reconciliation for upgraded databases
acceptance: Databases with pre-existing tables reconcile without re-running SQL.
Fresh installs create all tables and record every migration version.
Partial table state raises a clear MigrationConflict error.
Reconciliation does not modify existing data in pre-existing tables.
Schema migrations skip CREATE TABLE and CREATE INDEX that already exist.

features.title: Real Chinese job matching evidence and metrics

research_refs.title: langchain-ai/openevals
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Start with a small domain-specific evaluation set and combine deterministic evaluators with human judgment where necessary.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not require an LLM judge, hosted service, or model API for the default evaluation loop.

research_refs.title: Anthropic: Demystifying evals for AI agents
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Separate capability from regression evals, inspect traces, and feed production failures back into continuously run offline datasets.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not wait for statistically powered A/B tests when one deterministic failure or one live trace already identifies an actionable defect.

research_refs.title: LangSmith Evaluation Concepts
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Combine offline regression and backtesting with online monitoring, then turn production feedback into versioned offline examples.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not require LangSmith hosting; implement the lifecycle locally with versioned JSON reports and pytest.

research_refs.title: Navigating the Evaluation Funnel to Optimize Iteration Speed for Recommender Systems
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Use a staged evaluation funnel that rejects unsuccessful changes with cheap necessary criteria before expensive online or human evaluation.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not use one offline metric or a fixed seven-day waiting period as the universal release decision.

local_constraints: Real Chinese job sources change independently and may share one browser failure, so repeated runs are not automatically independent evidence.
One owner can provide rapid pairwise labels, but public quality claims need broader, versioned evidence and a holdout set.
The default evaluation loop must run locally without a model API or hosted evaluation service.
Temporal novelty can be tested quickly with timestamped snapshot pairs; natural multi-day use remains useful for release confidence.
acceptance: A single real Live Loop can generate rapid engineering feedback immediately; it is explicitly insufficient for public quality claims.
Each candidate change passes deterministic regression and saved-snapshot replay before a live source run.
Rapid recommendation review compares baseline and candidate on the same jobs and labels only changed or uncertain Top-10 results.
Temporal novelty is verified with at least two timestamped snapshots or deterministic snapshot-pair replay; no seven-day wait is required.
Public-claim readiness requires at least 50 human-labeled Chinese jobs and 3 independent real snapshots spanning at least 2 source-refresh windows.
Metrics (P@10, NDCG@10, FNR, valid-link rate, duplicates caught, source uptime) are script-generated from labeled data.

Seven qualitative evidence items are recorded: jobs found, valid link rate, dedup count, source reliability ranking, best/worst match examples, hard-filter false negatives, actual applications submitted.
Regression, comparison, holdout, and live datasets are versioned separately with provenance and annotation guidance.
Metrics serve as internal baselines — no threshold gate is set. Synthetic regression metrics remain separate.
Every human-labeled hard-filter error is converted into a deterministic regression test before the next candidate comparison or live smoke run.

features.title: Personal field trial and supported Agent matrix
acceptance: Rapid compatibility and recommendation feedback may be completed in one session and must not wait for a fixed seven-day window.
Release evidence uses at least 3 independent sessions across at least 2 dates; a seven-day soak is optional for stable-release and retention research.
Only roles located in mainland China or explicitly serving the China market count toward trial metrics.
JobFindsMe is used through at least two Agent hosts — ZCode plus one of Codex/Claude Code/Qwen Code — completing the same privacy and workflow scenarios.
Changed or uncertain Top-10 results are pairwise-labeled against the current baseline and feed M14; unchanged results are not repeatedly labeled.
Source failures, duplicates, invalid links, and ranking bad cases are recorded.
The field-trial report distinguishes observed facts from assumptions, and synthetic scores from real labels.

features.title: SPA Connector hardening (removed — redundant with 5 CDP platforms)
acceptance: SPA browser behavior is dependency-injected and contract-tested without live network access.
ByteDance, Meituan, Didi, and Bilibili payload variants normalize into valid job records.
Browser failures preserve cached jobs and update source health instead of breaking the search.
The browser extra installs declared Playwright, requests, and websocket dependencies.
Doctor distinguishes optional browser readiness from required Core readiness.
Every source advertised as verified has a dated live field-trial report.

features.title: BOSS CDP browser bridge hardening
acceptance: The CDP bridge navigates to a BOSS origin before invoking the same-origin search endpoint.
CDP target and WebSocket resources are closed on success and failure.
API, authentication, protocol, and empty-result behavior are distinguishable.
BOSS payload mapping and discovery fallback have deterministic automated tests.
BOSS is advertised as verified only after a dated logged-in field trial.

features.title: Schema-aware migration reconciliation
acceptance: Migration reconciliation validates required columns before recording a version.
Missing indexes are created when existing tables have a compatible schema.
Same-name tables with incompatible schemas raise a clear MigrationConflict.
Fresh install, compatible upgrade, incompatible upgrade, and repeat execution are tested.

features.title: RC5 release truth and documentation alignment
acceptance: README lists 5 CDP platform connectors (BOSS/Liepin/51job/Zhaopin/Lagou).
Deleted connectors (Playwright/SSR/ATS) are documented with removal reasons.
Package, Spec, README, release evidence, Git tag, and prerelease version agree.
The RC5 install command references an existing Git tag.
M14 and M15 remain open until real Chinese recommendation evidence is complete.

features.title: Stable job classification and list presentation
acceptance: Recruitment track (campus/social/unknown) and employment type (internship/full-time/part-time/contract/unknown) are independent typed fields.
Explicit source data wins over conservative text inference; unknown values are never presented as formal full-time roles.
Job summaries always include both classification fields and the official apply URL.
MCP text output uses one stable, human-readable block per job with the apply URL immediately after the job line.
MCP structuredContent remains machine-readable and retains job IDs, evidence, scores, classifications, and URLs.
CLI markdown output uses the same stable job presentation.
Connector, normalization, Core, MCP, and CLI regression tests cover campus/social and internship/full-time examples.

features.title: Browser connector crash containment
acceptance: Default source discovery never launches Playwright, Chrome, or a CDP browser session.
Previously persisted browser source subscriptions are skipped unless the current search explicitly enables browser sources.
Playwright does not fall back to the user's system Google Chrome when its managed Chromium is unavailable.
Browser sources remain available through explicit opt-in and preserve cached-result degradation behavior.
README and source catalog clearly separate default HTTP sources from opt-in browser sources.
Regression tests prove default searches cannot call SPA or BOSS browser connectors.

features.title: 5 CDP platform connectors (simplified from 12)
acceptance: Default sources: BOSS直聘 + 猎聘 + 前程无忧 + 智联 + 拉勾.
All five sources use the local CDP browser bridge; BOSS additionally requires account login.
Deleted connectors: Playwright SPA (字节/美团/滴滴/B站), Baidu SSR, Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, JsonLdCareerSite — all redundant with platforms or zero China output.
source_catalog returns exactly 5 sources for China locations.
Connector contract tests cover mapping, resource cleanup, and explicit extraction failure.
Each platform remains in_progress until a dated live Loop report proves a successful real extraction.
Repeated job content is idempotent: A→B→A does not crash or create a duplicate version.

features.title: AGENTS.md — framework-agnostic Agent instructions
acceptance: AGENTS.md contains workflow, output rules, privacy, and BOSS login check.
Works for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, ZCode, and any MCP agent.
Proactive BOSS login check before first search.
Score threshold and output format enforced.

features.title: Generic MCP install + match score threshold
acceptance: jobfindsme config outputs standard MCP JSON for any agent.
jobfindsme install --path supports arbitrary config paths.
RankingMatcher.match() accepts min_score (default 0.10).
Results below threshold are silently filtered.

features.title: Measured live-search Loop and field-trial telemetry
acceptance: Core returns typed per-source status, elapsed time, discovered/unique/version counts, cache degradation, matching time, and end-to-end time.
The Loop writes a privacy-minimized local report without resume text or full job descriptions.
Automatic quality checks cover source success, URL shape, required fields, unknown classifications, duplicate URLs, and average score.
A search only returns jobs from its active source configuration; cached jobs from removed sources cannot pollute a run.
A Loop run can generate the existing M14/M15 pending Top-10 human-label template.
Automatic checks explicitly do not claim human relevance or real link validity.
Local-fixture success and source-failure paths are regression tested.

features.title: Source truth, query planning, and catalog reconciliation

research_refs.title: Career-Ops
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Treat configured portals and observed listings as explicit, inspectable source state.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not let a host Agent's browser reasoning become the canonical source of truth.

research_refs.title: Playwright Locators and Auto-waiting
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Prefer current user-facing or explicit selector contracts and bounded waiting for dynamic pages.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not depend on long DOM-coupled CSS or XPath chains.

research_refs.title: Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Measure and repair source and data truth before tuning downstream ranking.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not treat a ranking improvement as compensation for incomplete or stale source records.

local_constraints: Chinese recruitment pages change frequently and may require a user-owned browser session.
A partial search page cannot prove that an absent job is closed.
The default path must not require a model API or a hosted evaluation service.
User-customized source subscriptions must survive catalog upgrades.
acceptance: Discovery distinguishes complete snapshots from partial search pages; only complete snapshots may close absent jobs.
Platform queries preserve one primary role and the requested city instead of concatenating multiple roles into one brittle keyword.
Existing default Search Plans can reconcile a newer maintained source catalog without overwriting explicitly customized sources.
Catalog-managed sources refresh their query when the primary target role changes; custom sources remain unchanged.
Recruitment track and employment type extraction is measured per source; unknown values remain visible and never silently satisfy strict filters.
Regression tests cover partial snapshots, location propagation, source-catalog upgrades, and unknown classification policy.

features.title: Research-gated evaluation-driven engineering loop

research_refs.title: OpenAI Evals
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep versioned, use-case-specific evaluation data and custom deterministic graders.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not require an OpenAI API or copy the framework when local Pydantic reports and pytest cover the current need.

research_refs.title: Anthropic: Demystifying evals for AI agents
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Define capabilities with evals, retain traces, and combine code, human, and later model graders.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not treat an automatic grader or a saturated regression suite as proof of user value.

research_refs.title: LangSmith Evaluation Concepts
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Turn online failures into offline cases, validate fixes offline, then confirm with new live runs.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not introduce LangSmith as a mandatory hosted dependency.

research_refs.title: Google Rules of Machine Learning
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep the end-to-end pipeline solid, log serving-time evidence, and optimize measured product goals.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not add complex ranking models before simple data and pipeline failures are resolved.

research_refs.title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Evaluate system dimensions separately instead of hiding failures behind one composite score.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not apply RAG-specific metrics directly to job discovery or replace job-domain human labels.

local_constraints: Core evaluation must work without a model API or hosted evaluation platform.
Reports cannot contain resume text, full job descriptions, cookies, or browser credentials.
Chinese platform anti-bot behavior and page changes require dated live evidence in addition to fixtures.
Human labels are scarce, so automatic operational checks and human recommendation labels must remain separate.
Generated engineering actions are proposals and cannot mutate Spec, Feature status, or code automatically.
acceptance: High-risk design features can declare a machine-checked Research Gate covering an open-source implementation, an official guide, and a paper or benchmark.
Each research reference records both the adopted pattern and the rejected or deferred pattern, plus project-local constraints.
Multiple Live Loop reports and an optional human benchmark aggregate into separate runtime, data-truth, and recommendation signals.
Measured failures map to owned engineering proposals with priority, target, acceptance criteria, and required regression tests.
Operational evidence and human recommendation evidence are both required before public quality claims.
The analyzer never edits Spec, Feature status, or implementation code.

features.title: Low-latency search modes, multi-city coverage, and evidence output

research_refs.title: Career-Ops provider registry
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Prefer source-specific public JSON APIs for Tencent, Meituan, Alibaba, Greenhouse, Lever, and similar providers before browser automation.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not assume an observed endpoint is permanent or acceptable for high-volume use; every adopted provider needs its own policy and live-evidence review.

research_refs.title: mergedao/mcp-jobs
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep the interactive MCP surface direct and separate bounded job-list discovery from on-demand detail retrieval.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not launch a new browser per source, return silent empty-success results, or discard durable state and evaluation evidence.

research_refs.title: RFC 5861: stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Serve explicitly marked cached data on the low-latency path and separate expensive refresh from interactive response time.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not treat cached jobs as fresh or hide source failures from diagnostics.

research_refs.title: Playwright browser guidance
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep browser automation bounded and observable instead of making every user interaction an exhaustive browser crawl.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not make Playwright a required second browser runtime when the user-owned CDP session already provides authenticated access.

local_constraints: Chinese recruitment platforms have uneven yield, latency, login requirements, and anti-bot behavior.
Interactive users need results quickly; monitoring and evaluation need broad source coverage.
Multiple requested cities must each be searched rather than silently dropping all but the first.
Recommendation text must remain deterministic and must not depend on the host Agent inventing reasons.
acceptance: Interactive search defaults to fast refresh, cache mode performs no remote discovery, and full mode remains explicit.
Live Loop and scheduled monitoring always use full refresh.
Fast mode refreshes the preferred source for every requested city and reuses other configured source caches.
Supported Chinese city names are translated to the platform's required city identifiers before BOSS discovery.
Search diagnostics expose refresh mode, end-to-end time, matching time, per-source state, and cache use.
An empty browser refresh with existing records is reported as degraded cache use rather than a successful proof of zero available jobs.
Doctor distinguishes an authenticated empty response from explicit authentication failure and does not tell users to log in again without evidence.
MCP search configuration persists recruitment track and employment type so strict filters execute in Core rather than in host-Agent post-processing.
A requested minimum salary compares against the posted lower bound; unknown recruitment track or employment type cannot silently satisfy an explicit strict filter.
Cached BOSS rows created before explicit classification fields are interpreted consistently until a fresh source record replaces them.
Stable text output includes role, company, location, recruitment track, employment type, salary when known, match percentage, recommendation reasons, warnings, and direct apply URL.
Regression tests prove multi-city source planning and prevent remote access in cache mode.

features.title: Persistent incremental job radar and novelty-aware results

research_refs.title: Career-Ops
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Treat a job search as a persistent local workflow with durable job state instead of a stateless list-generation request.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not copy automatic application behavior or require a hosted model for the deterministic state loop.

research_refs.title: Google Rules of Machine Learning
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Define measurable product goals and keep serving-time evidence before adding ranking complexity.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not optimize raw click or discovery counts when repeated or low-quality jobs waste user time.

research_refs.title: Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Make canonical identity, history, and source provenance first-class before using downstream scores.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not hide identity or history failures behind a single recommendation metric.

local_constraints: Users may access the same local workspace from different MCP-compatible Agents.
The default workflow must remain useful without a model API or hosted account.
A repeated search must not lose saved, applied, or rejected state.
Novelty claims must come from persisted job identity and version evidence, not Agent conversation memory.
acceptance: The first successful search creates a per-Search-Plan result baseline backed by durable canonical job identifiers.
A later search classifies results as new, materially changed, reopened, closed, or unchanged.
Unchanged jobs already shown or rejected are suppressed by default; saved and applied jobs remain queryable and are never silently reset.
No-result output distinguishes no qualified delta from source failure or an empty cache.
Diagnostics expose new, changed, reopened, closed, repeated-suppressed, and low-relevance-filtered counts.
The human-facing digest never pads the response with old or weak jobs merely to reach a count.
Regression tests cover repeat searches, cross-Agent state reuse, job version changes, source failure, and explicit history requests.

features.title: Effective cross-source coverage and bounded detail enrichment

research_refs.title: mergedao/mcp-jobs
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep list discovery lightweight and retrieve details only for selected candidates.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not equate a configured platform or raw list-card count with verified recommendation coverage.

research_refs.title: Playwright Locators and Auto-waiting
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Use bounded, observable detail extraction with resilient user-facing locators where browser access is necessary.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not fetch every detail page or make interactive latency depend on the slowest blocked source.

research_refs.title: Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Measure source field completeness and provenance before tuning ranking weights.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not compensate for missing descriptions or classifications by boosting incomplete records.

local_constraints: Chinese platforms have uneven data fields, latency, login requirements, and anti-bot behavior.
Detail fetching must have per-source budgets and cannot open unbounded browser tabs.
Unknown recruitment track or employment type cannot silently satisfy an explicit strict filter.
A source must provide incremental qualified jobs before it is promoted as a default recommendation source.
acceptance: Each source declares a transport class: structured_api, public_http, authenticated_browser, browser_dom, or local_import.
Source selection prefers structured API/HTTP and never starts a browser when a verified non-browser connector can satisfy the same source.
Every source exposes a maturity state, field-completeness profile, recent yield, latency, and failure reason.
List-card records declare their detail level and are not treated as complete job descriptions.
The system enriches only a bounded set of role-qualified candidates before final ranking.
Recruitment track, employment type, experience, and job description extraction have source-specific contract tests.
Blocked or zero-yield sources are cooled down and cannot hold the interactive response open indefinitely.
Evaluation compares BOSS-only, multi-source discovery, and multi-source enriched ranking using Qualified Unique Jobs@10 and non-primary-source incremental gain.
README source claims are generated or manually gated from dated Live Loop and human-label evidence.

completed: Liepin and Zhilian list-card records support best-effort detail-page enrichment for at most three candidates per source.
Detail enrichment has a total time budget, closes its temporary CDP target, and degrades to the original list-card record on failure.
Normalized source evidence distinguishes list_card, detail_page, and structured_source descriptions and records detail provenance.
Wuyou and Lagou remain list discovery sources and are not advertised as detail-enriched.
remaining: Declare transport class, maturity, completeness, recent yield, and latency for every source.
Add source-specific recruitment track, employment type, and experience extraction contracts.
Implement cooldown for blocked or zero-yield sources.
Run the cross-source enriched ranking evaluation and gate public source claims with dated evidence.

features.title: Evidence-bound profile-derived Search Plan proposal

research_refs.title: Career-Ops
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Reduce repeated setup by deriving a reusable search configuration from durable local profile state.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not silently persist inferred preferences or require a hosted model to construct the proposal.

research_refs.title: Google Rules of Machine Learning
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Start with observable, explainable heuristics and expose uncertainty before adding learned preference prediction.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not present heuristic salary or location guesses as measured user intent.

research_refs.title: Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Preserve evidence provenance and confirmation boundaries for profile-derived decisions.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not turn missing or noisy resume fields into confident downstream filters.

local_constraints: Only confirmed local profile facts may influence a suggested Search Plan.
Resume locations describe history and cannot be treated as confirmed job-location preference.
Experience alone cannot justify a desired salary floor.
The proposal must be returned during the fast setup flow but cannot be persisted until the user confirms it.
Missing recruitment track or employment type remains unknown instead of defaulting every user to social full-time work.
acceptance: suggest_plan reads only the latest confirmed ProfileSummary and returns ready=false when none exists.
The proposal includes role, location, experience, recruitment, and employment hints with reasoning and explicit confirmation fields.
Salary remains unset unless the profile contains confirmed salary-preference evidence.
setup_profile auto-confirm returns the proposal without requiring a second Agent round trip.
The proposal is never persisted as an active Search Plan without configure_search confirmation.
Doctor validates the actual registered MCP tool count instead of a stale hard-coded number.
